I'm Rubber You're Glue: Accusing Others of Your Crimes

This tactic is used to confuse the public, especially an uninformed audience, by accusing an innocent person of the behavior or crime that the accuser committed themself. Unless the audience is already familiar with the relevant facts of the situation, it will be difficult to discern which party is being honest.

Fight With Your Mind is brought to you by Bootstrap Commercial Arts

Fighting injustice with wide reaching visual, virtual, and verbal communication.

After spending time working in a marketing industry that capitalizes on the science and psychology of public manipulation, the former corporate marketers and founders of Bootstrap parted ways with big business.

Bootstrap Commercial Arts, founder of the movement Fight With Your Mind, was created to better align a set of skills from the marketing industry with the concept that marketing can be and should be about honesty and communication, and that people, not unaccountable entities, should be running our economy.

Businesses should have products or services of value that are presented to demographics that possess an actual need, desire, or demand for what a business supplies. Marketers should facilitate that honest communication between the business and the public.

Like any powerful tool, marketing can be misused, and people can be hurt and taken advantage of. Unfortunately, marketing has become synonymous with brainwashing at times, and the term information warfare has become a threat that everyone should understand in order to protect themselves.

Fight With Your Mind is one of 4 arms of Bootstrap Commercial Arts, all intended to fight injustice with commercial art. Learn more about Bootstrap and it's other arms of change:

Fighting dishonest marketing practices and information warfare by providing honesty to the public and honesty to the client.

Fighting the injustice and inequality homeless endure by providing a four step program, a community and support group, resource center, training hub, and employment entry program that requires no government assistance, capital, or public monetary donation to operate.

Fighting the culture that drives information warfare through social media alternatives. Taking control of the future and not accepting a dire fate.
